title: Retired artifact revision claims
description: Committed transactions whose recorded artifact revisions the live revision ledger deliberately no longer honors. One entry per transaction; it retires only the named claims of that receipt, never an artifact's later history. Read by the validator's revision-ledger check (system/VALIDATION.md).

cause.description: rolled-back: the transaction's ledger and canonical writes were undone outside the gateway and are not restored. migrated: a recorded migration under tools/migrations/ rewrote these ledger keys (none does today).
